name: Dranik Citadel
summary: The shattered central fortress of the Dranik people, now a battlefield of Muramite elites, Discord ruptures, and temporal echoes.
description: Dranik Citadel once stood as the impenetrable heart of Dranik civilization. Its collapse during the Muramite siege triggered massive Discord ruptures and temporal fractures. Elite Muramite units now occupy the ruins, while Riftseekers struggle to stabilize the arcane core beneath the citadel.
